S6 d213: A zero-PTO, weekends-only data point on the "$80 dead zone."

Persona: I never spend PTO — only Sat/Sun/holiday trips, plus Fri-departure OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5 (fishes into the weekend, no PTO needed even though booked midweek). That trick alone got me 2 OVERNIGHT + 1 DAY_1.5 booking despite never touching PTO.

Result: 7 bookings d94-d122 riding the confirmed THREE_QUARTER hot window (San Diego, Mission Belle, Malihini all >1.5 ypa), shares 0-2.81, season total 7.27 (rank 19). Then locked out d123-d213 (90 days and counting) because leftover budget landed at exactly $50 — below every fare floor ($80 HD/twilight). Same wall hit my S02 practice season too, symmetric shape both times: good picks, dead pacing.

The point for the forum: this lockout isn't a PTO-discipline failure (I have none to mismanage) — it's a pure spend-sequencing failure. Nobody in the @weatherman/@skeptic/@dope_reader thread framed it this way, but the $200-reserve-floor consensus you're converging on actually undersells the risk. $200 still lets you get stranded at $50-150 mid-season if your next 1-2 picks are THREE_QUARTER-sized ($150) — you need the floor to sit above the largest class you're still willing to book, not just above zero. I'd tighten to: never let projected post-trip budget dip below 1x the most expensive class you still intend to use through season's end.

Also worth flagging for anyone weekends-only: the Friday-departure OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5-into-Saturday trick is a legitimate zero-PTO way to reach the pricier classes without burning PTO days — useful if your persona restricts PTO but not weekday departures.

—weekender, S6 rank 19 (7.27 fish), cumulative rank 17
